purpose: A contract for a remote or cloud-hosted bot that cannot reach Local Studio's loopback API directly. The operator only writes an edit spec. The bot supplies the source video and the cut, then hands both off through a dedicated git branch — never a network call to this PC.

roles.operator: Write the spec only (title, goal, length, captions, look). Do not attach footage.
roles.bot: Find or make the source, edit it, and push a package that includes the video file plus bundle.json with edit_spec_id.

why_this_exists: Local Studio binds to 127.0.0.1 only and is not reachable from another machine or container by design (see README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md). This channel is an offline handoff, not a remote API — the only thing this repository accepts from a remote bot is a git push to the branch named below.

channel.rule: Push commits only to this repository's main branch. Never attempt to reach an IP address or hostname belonging to the local operator's machine — this repository is the only sanctioned channel.
channel.folder_naming: One top-level folder per submission, named '<UTC timestamp>-<short-slug>' (e.g. 2026-08-23T07-19-00Z-payoff-hook). The folder name must be unique per submission; it is used to detect duplicates.

limits.media_max_bytes_note: 2 GB by default; the operator can raise or lower this with HANDOFF_MAX_MEDIA_BYTES in local_studio/.env. A package with an unsupported extension or an oversized file is skipped entirely, not truncated.
limits.bundle_max_bytes_note: 4 MB by default (HANDOFF_MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES). bundle.json is metadata/EDL/artifacts only — it should never need to be this large.
limits.packages_per_cycle_note: The watcher processes at most this many pending folders per poll (HANDOFF_MAX_PACKAGES_PER_CYCLE via --max-per-cycle, if the operator changes it). Extra submissions simply wait for a later cycle — do not resubmit or assume a delay means failure.

package_contents.bundle_json: A file named bundle.json at the folder root, using the same schema Local Studio's own project-bundle export/import already uses: local-video-workspace.project-bundle/v1.

project.title: string
project.source_path: workspace-relative path this media will be copied to, e.g. inputs/handoff/<folder-name>/source.mp4
project.output_path: workspace-relative path for the render, e.g. outputs/handoff/<folder-name>.mp4

timeline.render_settings: optional, same fields Production's Finish Rack uses (platform, quality, caption_bg, music_track, ...)

project.caption: Instagram caption text, up to 2200 characters
project.edit_spec_id: required when fulfilling an operator spec — copy the id from the brief the operator sent

package_contents.media_file: The bot must include the actual video file. The operator does not provide it. Place it at the folder root using only the final path segment (source.mp4). Extra B-roll files listed on timeline.assets[].path go in the same folder.
package_contents.rule: Omit a job's 'status' field entirely so it is created fresh as queued+approved. Do not set 'status' to succeeded/failed unless you are intentionally replaying history, not requesting new work.

auto_upload_policy.rule: Setting bundle.project.handoff_auto_upload_requested: true and jobs[].payload.auto_upload: true only requests immediate Instagram publishing. It has no effect unless the PC's operator has separately started local_studio/handoff_watcher.py with --allow-auto-upload. Both conditions are required.
auto_upload_policy.default: Without that local opt-in, the instagram_publish job is created and left queued; a person runs it from the Production page when ready.
auto_upload_policy.render_is_different: A render job only produces a local MP4 file — it has no external effect — so it runs automatically once approved: true is set, independent of --allow-auto-upload.

processing: A background script on the operator's PC (local_studio/handoff_watcher.py) polls this branch, copies the media into its own workspace, and calls its own POST /api/projects/import with bundle.json verbatim. Processed folders are normally removed from the branch afterward — do not assume a folder stays on the branch as a permanent record.
never: Never attempt to connect to 127.0.0.1, localhost, or any LAN/WAN address for this project — only the git branch above is a sanctioned channel.
Never request, embed, or guess LOCAL_STUDIO_TOKEN, INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN, or any other credential in a package.
Never push to any repository or branch other than the one named in 'channel'.
Never assume a submission was applied — this channel has no delivery confirmation beyond the operator's own local logs.
